title: What If All 8 Billion Humans Stood in Texas?

scenes.text: What if all eight billion of us stood in Texas? We'd fit, with room to spare.
The world passed eight billion people in November 2022.
Texas covers about 262,000 square miles. Divide it equally, and everyone gets roughly 85 square meters.
That's about nine hundred square feet each, a room nine meters across for every single person.
But there'd be no farms, no roads, no hospitals, no sewage plants and no rivers to drink from.
Everyone would fit. Nothing that keeps us alive would.

description:

The area works out to roughly 85 square meters per person, but there'd be no room left for farms, hospitals or water.
